title: ServiceResourcePreference - Data API
description: Represents the service resource scheduling preferences that are considered as a business objective in the scheduling logic engine. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EndDate.description: The end date period that this preference is effective.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the service resource preference was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the service resource preference was last viewed.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The service resource preference record name.

OperatingHoursId.description: The operating hours associated with the service resource preference. This is a relationship field.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The owner of the service resource preference. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ServiceResourceId.description: The service resource associated with the service resource preference. This is a relationship field.

StartDate.description: The start date period that this preference is effective.

special_access_rules:
